body:
Two real, live bugs found by the founder actually playing the client:

1. "its still named redgarden" -- the fork's own rebrand commit
   (2233d08) only touched README/CLAUDE.md docs; every CI artifact
   (RedGarden.exe, RedGarden_Client/Server zips, the Construct Bundle,
   the upload-artifact name) was still 100% unmodified REDGARDEN CI.
   Renamed throughout: ECOWAR.exe, ECOWAR_Client/Server,
   ECOWAR_CONSTRUCT.txt, ecowar-build.

2. "it launches 10 v 10 instead of 1 v 1" -- root cause: PLAY.bat
   never passed --matchmaker-port, so the client's own default
   (queue_port = 7778, apps/arena/src/main.c) silently connected to
   REDGARDEN's OWN live 10v10 (lobby-size 20) pool at the same public
   IP, never ECOWAR's own real, separate 1v1 pool (ops/systemd/
   ecowar-matchmaker.service, :9779, lobby-size 2, staged specifically
   to avoid this exact collision). The server bundle's own
   START_ARENA_POOL.sh had the identical bug (hardcoded --listen-port
   7778 --lobby-size 20). Fixed both to target ECOWAR's own real
   1v1 pool. red_garden_matchmaker/red_garden_arena_server themselves
   stay the same real, already-generic shared binaries (not renamed).

Verified live: started ECOWAR's own real matchmaker + 1-bot pool on
this box (198.58.107.85:9779 -- confirmed this box's own public IP
matches what the client already connects to), confirmed the bot
queued and is waiting for a real human to fill the 1v1 lobby. Real
release v0.5.0 confirmed shipping ECOWAR_Client_build_7_da0dc4b.zip /
ECOWAR_Server_build_7_da0dc4b.zip (not RedGarden-named). CI green on
both jobs.

Also investigated, curated to EMILY/BACKLOG.md, not fixed this pass:
(1) the "card interface not visible" report -- the 16-card system
(fc257c4) is real, complete server-side logic but has zero real
callers anywhere, no keybind/UI/AI trigger wires it to any
player-facing surface; needs real design direction before building a
UI. (2) a real cart mana-regen lockup the founder diagnosed live to
the "Wanecall Grimoire" weapon item -- concrete lead left in BACKLOG
for whoever picks it up, including a suspicion it may also affect
REDGARDEN main (item catalog inherited unchanged from the fork).

ECOWAR commit da0dc4b. CI run 33112843952: both jobs green.
